name: LinkedIn Company Page Visitor Enrichment - Simplified
description: Captures LinkedIn company page visitors via Chrome extension, deduplicates against existing Google Sheet records, enriches via Explorium, and saves new visitors

nodes.name: Webhook - Chrome Extension
nodes.notes: Receives visitor data from Chrome extension. Expects: [{profileId, name, headline, company, email}]

nodes.name: Get Existing Visitors from Sheet
nodes.notes: Fetch all existing visitor records from Google Sheets. Set GOOGLE_SHEET_ID environment variable or manually update the URL.

nodes.name: Deduplicate Visitors
nodes.notes: Compare incoming visitors with existing records. Filter out duplicates.

nodes.name: Split Visitors for Processing
nodes.notes: Convert array to individual items for processing

nodes.name: Enrich via Explorium
nodes.notes: Call Explorium API to enrich visitor data

nodes.name: Merge Enrichment Data
nodes.notes: Merge original visitor data with Explorium enrichment results

nodes.name: Append to Google Sheets
nodes.notes: Append enriched visitor record to Google Sheets using Sheets API

nodes.name: Return Success Response
nodes.notes: Return success response to webhook caller
